note: Readings of our own labels that a named person has confirmed. `read_as` is the full name the label stands for: it is looked up in place of the label, by the same exact-name rule as every other name. `plain_word` says the label is an ordinary word and is never linked through an abbreviation. A reading is a statement about a name, not a clinical approval: the links it leads to are stored pending like all others.

No full name is given yet: in the data the symptom is affirmed in 43 cases, labelled swine flu (12), influenza (10), common cold (7), sinusitis (6), measles (5) and allergy (3), which points to "a cold" and not to "feeling cold"; HPO has no finding of that name and MONDO has the disease "common cold". Reading it as "common cold" awaits the owner's confirmation
